source.changes: Adapted the eleven stat blocks Allosaurus and Ancient Black, Blue, Brass, Bronze, Copper, Gold, Green, Red, Silver and White Dragon on PDF pages 265–344 into typed mechanical fields and implementation keys, and recorded the Animals section heading on PDF page 344 as an index entry without a stat block. Retained every skill, immunity, sense, trait, action, spell list and legendary action, with continuation text across columns and pages. Mechanic keys and typed details are Edda additions. No playable NPC behavior is granted.
